title: Merge or hollow brushes
summary: Use the Modify menu's constructive solid geometry commands on selected brushes.
outcome: Selected brushes are merged or hollowed, and the result is checked before further editing.

sections.title: Apply CSG

steps.title: Select whole brushes
steps.text: Use Editor selection rather than Face or Vertex mode. Select two adjacent brushes for Merge, or one box brush for Hollow.

steps.title: Run a command
steps.text: Choose Modify > CSG > Merge to combine the adjacent brushes into one convex brush, or Hollow to turn the selected box into enclosing brush geometry. Hollow uses the current Grid size for wall thickness.

steps.title: Inspect the result
steps.text: Check the new faces in Camera and the grid views. If the result is not the enclosure or combined shape you wanted, Undo, adjust the source brushes, and retry.

tips: Merge needs a convex result. If it cannot merge, choose two adjacent boxes that form a convex shape.
